caption: The drawing depicts a single bird, specifically an eagle, standing on a round, grayish platform. The eagle is rendered in a side profile facing to the left. Its body is primarily colored in shades of gray, with a textured, scale-like pattern on the head, neck, and legs. The bird's wings and tail are darker, almost black, with detailed feather lines. The beak is yellow with an orange tip, and there are distinct blue markings around the eye area. The eye itself is yellow with a black pupil. The talons are thick and robust, colored yellow, with black claws gripping the platform. The background is plain and off-white, emphasizing the eagle as the singular subject of the composition.
title: Pa. German Eagle
